AdMapix Intelligence Assistant 1.0.0

- Initial release of AdMapix skill for ad intelligence & app analytics via api.admapix.com
- Supports searching ad creatives, app analysis, rankings, download/revenue tracking, and market insights
- Automatic language detection (Chinese/English) with consistent language and number formatting throughout interactions
- Smart complexity classification: routes simple queries internally; deep/comparative analyses via integrated Deep Research Framework with automated polling and reporting
- Includes API key checking, data disclaimer displays, and response customization based on user language
